description: This file defines the LLMSwitcher class, which manages switching between multiple LLM services at runtime, including inference and function registration methods.

classes.name: LLMSwitcher
classes.description: A pipeline class that switches between different LLMs at runtime, inheriting from ServiceSwitcher with StrategyType.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LLMSwitcher with a list of LLM services and a switching strategy.

methods.name: llms
methods.description: Property that returns the list of managed LLM services.

methods.name: active_llm
methods.description: Property that returns the currently active LLM service.

methods.name: run_inference
methods.description: Runs inference asynchronously using the active LLM with the provided context.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a function handler for all LLMs, with optional start callback and interruption behavior.

methods.name: register_direct_function
methods.description: Registers a direct function handler for all LLMs, with optional interruption behavior.
